name: Candy and sweets
one_line: Biscuit paths, icing hills and glossy sugar.
look_words: A world you could eat. Pink icing and mint cream for the ground, biscuit and wafer for paths and bridges, cake houses, gumdrop bushes, candy-cane posts. Colours are soft pastels with small glossy highlights, like sugar glaze; shapes are plump, rounded and a bit melted. Light is bright and soft with pale shadows. Gold foil and grape purple mark what to collect and the goal. Strong red is kept for harm only, so scenery sweets stay pink, mint and cream. The player is gingerbread brown, which reads well on all the pastels. Motion is bouncy and gooey: jelly wobbles, drips, sprinkles scattering. Avoid dark scenes, realism, sharp shapes, heavy bloom on the gloss, and too many strong colours at once.

palette.name: sweet shop
palette.notes: A pink world: keep red rare and strong so it still means harm. Text sits on the plum card.

look_wish: soft glossy shading with a little tilt-shift blur, or none

upgrade.why: makes it read as a tray of real sweets photographed up close
smooth melted blobs and icing shapes modelled in code

music.notes: Sugary but short loops get tiring: vary it.

Glossy sugar highlights, soft pastel pink, mint and cream with a few bright cherry reds, bright soft daylight, pale blue sky, cheerful.
